title.zh: 【纳斯达克上市公司 SVRN 收购 NEAR 基础设施提供商 FastNEAR】
title.en: 【纳斯达克上市公司 SVRN 收购 NEAR 基础设施提供商 FastNEAR】

current_state.zh: Nasdaq-listed SVRN has acquired FastNEAR, the NEAR RPC, archival and data infrastructure provider that serves over 3.5 billion requests and 100+ TB of data monthly, making it SVRN's first operating business alongside its asset treasury, with founders Evgeny Kuzyakov and Mike Purvis joining the company.
current_state.en: Nasdaq-listed SVRN has acquired FastNEAR, the NEAR RPC, archival and data infrastructure provider that serves over 3.5 billion requests and 100+ TB of data monthly, making it SVRN's first operating business alongside its asset treasury, with founders Evgeny Kuzyakov and Mike Purvis joining the company.
